texts.title: Text A: Westbrook Public Library, Information for Members

paragraphs.label: A
paragraphs.text:
OPENING HOURS: Monday to Thursday 9.00 am to 8.00 pm. Friday 9.00 am to 5.00 pm. Saturday 10.00 am to 4.00 pm. Closed on Sundays and public holidays.

JOINING: Membership is free for residents. To join, please bring proof of your address, such as a recent utility bill or bank statement, to the main desk. Your card will be issued on the same day.

BORROWING: Adults may borrow up to 10 books for 3 weeks. Children may borrow up to 6 books. DVDs and music CDs may be borrowed for 1 week (maximum 3 items) for a charge of £1 each. Items can be renewed twice, online or by phone, unless another member has reserved them.

LATE FEES: 20p per day for each item borrowed by an adult. There are no late fees for children's books.

COMPUTERS: Free internet access is available for 1 hour per day. Please bring photo identification to book a computer. Printing costs 10p per page.

STUDY ROOMS: A quiet study room on the second floor can be reserved in advance for up to 4 hours at a time. Please set your mobile phone to silent in all areas of the library.

texts.title: Text B: City Language Centre, Spring Term Evening Courses

paragraphs.label: B
paragraphs.text:
Learn Spanish, French, German, Italian or Mandarin this spring!

Courses run for 10 weeks, with one class each week from 7.00 pm to 9.00 pm. Beginners' classes are held on Mondays and Tuesdays, and intermediate classes on Wednesdays and Thursdays.

Fees: £120 per term. Students and people over 65 pay a reduced fee of £90. The course book costs an additional £25 and is not included in the fee.

How to enrol: Online or in person at the centre by 15 January. Classes begin in the week of 20 January.

FREE TASTER SESSION: Saturday 11 January at 10.30 am. No booking is needed.

Please note: each class is limited to 12 students. If fewer than 6 students enrol, the class will be cancelled and fees will be refunded in full. Students who attend at least 80% of classes receive a certificate of attendance.

texts.title: Text C: Sunnyside Hostel, Guest Information

paragraphs.label: C
paragraphs.text:
CHECK-IN from 2.00 pm. CHECK-OUT by 10.30 am. If you are leaving later in the day, you may leave your luggage in our storage room free of charge until 6.00 pm.

ROOMS: Dormitory beds (6 or 8 beds per room) are £18 per night. Private rooms are £45 per night and include breakfast. Breakfast is served from 7.30 am to 9.30 am and costs £4 for dormitory guests.

KITCHEN: Open from 7.00 am to 11.00 pm. Please wash your dishes after use.

QUIET HOURS: 11.00 pm to 7.00 am. Please respect other guests.

SECURITY: Each guest has a locker. Please bring your own padlock, or buy one at reception for £3.

WI-FI: Free in the common room only. Wi-Fi is not available in the bedrooms.

Smoking is not permitted anywhere in the building or the garden. Guests under 18 must be accompanied by an adult.
